From today, Runna subscribers can use the new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna adds heat-aware training tool

Personal running training app Runna announced three updates today, aimed at supporting users throughout the entire training cycle, from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

Starting today, the "Adapt for Heat" feature is officially launched. Runna will help users find cooler running times and suggest adjusted pace targets based on perceived temperature, training duration, and specific sessions.

"Adapt for Heat" displays color-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to quickly identify the most suitable times for running and plan accordingly.

The following is Runna's introduction to the new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once a user launches a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system automatically generates a corresponding plan. Runna's head coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury."

Finally, the platform also announced that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will be launched in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans and automatically switch to the next one after completing a plan, further streamlining the long-term training process.

The following is Runna's introduction to the benefits of "Upcoming Plans":

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races,阶段性 goals (note: this term is retained as-is due to ambiguous translation; suggest "phase-based goals"), and training phases into one clear, year-long view. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—your preferred training schedule, estimated finish time, and current fitness level carry over seamlessly from your current plan to the next. Flexibility and full control: Every plan is editable, swappable, or deletable at any time, so runners stay fully in charge of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is built by Runna's expert coaches, grounded in established training principles, to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day readiness.
